name: verify-sign
description: Add an Artifact Verification (SscaArtifactVerification) step to an existing Harness pipeline to verify Cosign signatures on container or local-stage artifacts. Supports CI, Security, and CD Deploy (containerized step group). Supports Third-Party registries (Docker, ECR, GCR, GAR, ACR), Harness Artifact Registry (HAR), and Harness Local Stage artifacts. Only works with existing pipelines. Use when asked to verify signed artifacts, verify artifact signature, verify-sign, validate Cosign signature, or configure SscaArtifactVerification. Trigger phrases: verify sign, verify artifact, artifact verification, verify signature, verify-sign, SscaArtifactVerification, verify signed image, verify Cosign, HAR verification.
